The remediations are **opposite** \u2014 retry/alternate instance or region for capacity (LLM-SM-TRAIN-002) versus `request-service-quota-increase` for a zero quota (LLM-SM-TRAIN-003). Distinguish by reading **both** the `FailureReason` and `service-quotas get-service-quota`; a quota increase does nothing for a capacity shortfall, and a retry does nothing for a zero quota.\\n\\n## 3. `allow_percentage_invalid_samples` silently drops records\\n\\n- **Trap:** A customization job that reports `Completed` reads as \"all training data was used.\"\\n- **Correct reading:** When the recipe sets an invalid-sample tolerance (e.g. `allow_percentage_invalid_samples`), the job can **drop** malformed records up to that tolerance and still report `Completed` \u2014 the model trained on **less data than intended**. `Completed` \u2260 \"all data used\".
